decisions.title: Go version
decisions.rationale: Latest stable with Green Tea GC, improved generics, 30% less cgo overhead

decisions.title: PostgreSQL version
decisions.decision: PostgreSQL 18 (18.3, latest stable as of Feb 2026)

decisions.title: Health check + OpenAPI
decisions.decision: Include GET /health (DB ping + uptime) and GET /api/v1/openapi.yaml from day one
decisions.rationale: Standard for production services. Health check enables monitoring. OpenAPI enables frontend codegen.

decisions.title: Shared kernel packages
decisions.decision: pkg/money (shopspring/decimal wrapper), pkg/currency (ISO 4217), pkg/scope (Personal/Household), pkg/errs (typed DomainError with codes)
decisions.rationale: Minimal cross-context types. Only what multiple bounded contexts genuinely share.

decisions.title: Event bus implementation
decisions.decision: Custom sync+async composite event bus in internal/common/event/ (~300 lines). Bus (sync), AsyncBus (goroutine workers), CompositePublisher (sync first, then async). Event interface with EventName() string.
decisions.rationale: Simple, no external dependencies. Sync for critical side effects (balance projections), async for non-critical (notifications). Upgrade to Watermill if complexity warrants.

decisions.title: HTTP framework
decisions.decision: chi v5 with middleware chain: RequestID → slog Logger → Recovery → CORS → RateLimit. net/http compatible.
decisions.rationale: Locked in shape. chi is the standard Go router for DDD projects.

decisions.title: Database driver
decisions.decision: pgx v5 (jackc/pgx) with connection pool. No ORM.
decisions.rationale: Locked in shape. PostgreSQL-native, LISTEN/NOTIFY support, best Go PG driver.

decisions.title: Migration framework
decisions.decision: golang-migrate/migrate v4 with SQL migration files in migrations/ directory
decisions.rationale: Locked in shape. SQL-based, versioned, widely adopted.

decisions.title: DI approach
decisions.decision: Constructor injection with manual wiring in cmd/api/main.go. No DI framework.
decisions.rationale: Locked in shape. Compile-time safety. Consider google/wire at 30+ services.

decisions.title: Logging
decisions.decision: log/slog (stdlib) with JSON handler for production, text handler for development
decisions.rationale: Go 1.26 stdlib. No external logging library needed. Structured, leveled, context-aware.

decisions.title: Config loading
decisions.decision: os.Getenv with a Config struct. No viper or external config library.
decisions.rationale: Locked in shape. Simple, explicit, no magic.

decisions.title: Docker Compose
decisions.decision: Docker Compose with PostgreSQL 18, app service. .env file for local config.

decisions.title: Makefile targets
decisions.decision: build, test, lint (golangci-lint), migrate-up, migrate-down, migrate-create, docker-up, docker-down, run
decisions.rationale: Standard Go project targets. golangci-lint for comprehensive linting.

decisions.title: Initial migrations
decisions.decision: 001_extensions.up.sql (enable pgcrypto, pg_trgm), 002_event_outbox.up.sql (outbox table for async events)
decisions.rationale: pgcrypto for gen_random_uuid(), pg_trgm for description search. Outbox table needed by event bus from day one.

constraints: Domain layer (internal/*/domain/) must have zero external dependencies beyond pkg/ and shopspring/decimal + google/uuid
Shared kernel (pkg/) must remain minimal — only types genuinely needed by 2+ contexts
No circular imports between bounded context packages
All constructors must accept interfaces, not concrete types
Event bus must support both sync and async dispatch from initial release

research.relevance: Project structure, package layout, aggregate patterns, value objects
Event bus design, CompositePublisher, outbox table schema
Clean architecture layers, DI wiring, middleware chain, error handling, Makefile
